test_case.purpose: After workload scope approval, verify required domains maintain signed load floors throughout all thermal phases at high rail without platform failure.
required_package: Per-domain load floors and phase/ramp tolerances
test_case.test_command: DO NOT RUN. Resolve workload scope first; then execute only the approved profile through 0C hold, ramp-up, 40C hold and ramp-down, each one hour, at signed +5% rails.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be finalized before authoritative workload domains/floors are approved; afterward every required phase/domain must meet its oracle without error/hang.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS by guessing scope. All four phases and approved domain floors require evidence.
safety_gate: No chamber run until profile authorization
Abort on workload loss, moisture, overshoot, thermal, RAS or network fault
Preserve logs; no auto-retry; dry restoration
test_case.recovery: Approved scope must define coordinated stop; preserve phase evidence, return rails nominal, warm/dry, restore Windows/tool settings and do not auto-retry.
